Can I ask you something? he said.
Yes. Of course you can.
Are we going to die?
Sometime. Not now.
And we're still the good guys?
Yes.

Yes. Always.
Okay.

title: No Country for Old Men (Cormac McCarthy)
description: Rapid multi-turn conversational exchange with zero dialogue tags and trailing scene narration.
text:
You need to put it up.
What's that?
The coin. Don't put it in your pocket.
Why? It's your lucky coin.
Anything can be a coin. It's just a coin.
Where did you want me to put it?
Anywhere not in your pocket. Or it will get mixed in with the others and become just a coin. Which it is.
The man looked at him. He took the quarter from the counter and held it in his hand.
